say:1:1910505001:1.text: By the tides, the ocean waves have carried you safely back to me!
say:1:1910505001:1.source_cn: 波涛啊，洋流将你们平安送回来了！

say:2:1910505002:1.text: Hey! I only came back 'cause I was worried something had happened in the city. Don't even think about dragging me off again!
say:2:1910505002:1.source_cn: 喂，咱是担心城里出事才回来，别想着再把咱捉走！

say:3:1910505003:1.text: Did you run into any Deepfolk on your way back? Is anyone hurt?
say:3:1910505003:1.source_cn: 你们回来的路上遇到深海裔了吗，有没有受伤？

say:4:1910505004:1.text: The current is calmer near the gathering grounds. You should rest there first.
say:4:1910505004:1.source_cn: 集会地附近的水流平稳些，你们先去那里休息吧！

choice_prompt:5:1910505004.text: The current is calmer near the gathering grounds. You should rest there first.
choice_prompt:5:1910505004.source_cn: 集会地附近的水流平稳些，你们先去那里休息吧！

say:6:1910505005:1.text: This is terrible. The water cooled so quickly that it's no longer fit for spawning. I never thought this renewal season would end so soon.
say:6:1910505005:1.source_cn: 十分可惜，水温下降太快，已经不再适合繁育了。没想到这一...

say:7:1910505006:1.text: It is a pity. I had hoped that we might all become one family. But never mind that, my smooth and fluffy friends. As long as you're back safe and sound with us, that is enough.
say:7:1910505006:1.source_cn: 遗憾啊……原本以为能成为一家人的。不过没关系，光滑的朋...

say:8:1910505007:1.text: Matriarch Menoa has been looking for you everywhere. Tell her you're all back. She'll be delighted to know.
say:8:1910505007:1.source_cn: 摩淖亚在到处找你们呢，去给她报个信吧，她知道你们回来一...

choice:5:0:1.text: Have you given up on making us family?
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 你放弃让我们成为“家人”了？
choice:5:0:1.male: Have you given up on making us family?
choice:5:0:1.female: Have you given up on making us family?

choice:5:1:2.text: I worked so hard fixing the Cradle Pool, and now...
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 繁育池！我刚出力修好的繁育池！
choice:5:1:2.male: I worked so hard fixing the Cradle Pool, and now...
choice:5:1:2.female: I worked so hard fixing the Cradle Pool, and now...
